title: MOZAYYX Acquisition Corp. 8-K Filing
summary: MOZAYYX Acquisition Corp., a SPAC incorporated in the Cayman Islands and listed on the NYSE, announced that commencing April 20, 2026, holders of units (MZYX.U) may elect to separately trade the underlying Class A ordinary shares (MZYX) and redeemable warrants (MZYX.WS). The warrants are exercisable at $11.50 per share. No fractional warrants will be issued; only whole warrants will trade.
key_points: SPAC unit separation scheduled to commence April 20, 2026 on NYSE
Units (MZYX.U) will continue trading; Ordinary Shares (MZYX) and Warrants (MZYX.WS) will trade separately
Warrant exercise price: $11.50 per share, each whole warrant entitles holder to one ordinary share
Company is incorporated in Cayman Islands; executive office in Austin, TX
Transfer agent: Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company
Filed under Item 8.01 (Other Events) — routine corporate disclosure
